paite: Huan Solomon in a-inn kum sawm-le-thum alam a, huchi in a-inn pumpi alamzou vekta hi.
heading: Solomon Kumpi Inn
english: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

paite: Lebanon gammang inn, khuamvual li, khuam tung a sidar singpek tung ah alam a; adunglam tong zakhat ahi. Availam tong sawmnga ahi a, asanlam tong sawmthum ahi.
english: For he built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.

paite: Huai khuam a kinga dantan sawmli-le-nga tunglam ah sidar singphel a khuh ahi a; vual khat ah sawm-le-nga zel ahi.
english: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams that were on the pillars, fifteen in a row.

paite: Vual thum ah tohlette a-om a, vak leh vakte bel vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
english: There were beams in three rows, and window was facing window in three ranks.

paite: Kongkhak leh khuam tengteng singpek aning li nei a bawl ahi a, vak leh vakte vual thum in akigalsai vek uhi.
english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

paite: Inn lim khuam nei abawl a; adunglam tong sawmnga ahi a, availam tong sawmthum ahi. Huaite ma ah akhuamte leh ama a lutna tung kah toh inlim abawl hi.
english: He made the hall of pillars. Its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, with a porch before them, and pillars and a threshold before them.

paite: Avaihawmna ding laltutphah inlim, vaihawmna inlim, avaihawmna ding abawl hi. Huai pialkhang langkhat a pan langkhat pha a sidar sing a khuh ahi.
english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

paite: Ama tenna ding in, inn lim nung a, huangsung intual dang nei om pen huchi mah bang a bawl ahi. Huai inlim mah bang in Solomon in zi a Pharaoh tanu aneih, inn ding leng alamsak lai hi.
english: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the same construction. He made also a house for Pharaoh’s daughter (whom Solomon had taken as wife), like this porch.

paite: Hiai tengteng suang manpha pipi, ahun geihgeih a sek zel suang, atna a at a lam ahi. Sunglam leng, polam leng asuangphum a pan alek pha in, huchi mah bang in polam ah huangsung intual lianpi tanpha in.
english: All these were of costly stones, even of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.

paite: Suangphum suang manpha pipi, suang lian pipi, suang tong sawm leh suang tong giatte a lep ahi.
english: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.

paite: Huai tunglam ah suang manpha pipi, suang ahun geihgeih zel a sek leh sidar sing ahi.
english: Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.

paite: Akimvel in huangsung intual lianpi suangsek chial thum leh sidar singpek thuah khat a um ahi. TOUPA' inn huangsung intual sunggilzaw leh inn inlim mah bang in.
english: The great court around had three courses of cut stone with a course of cedar beams, like the inner court of Yahweh’s house and the porch of the house.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Tura a pan mi sawl in, Hiram asam hi.
heading: Hiram Nasep
english: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

paite: Huai mi Naphtali nam meithai tapa ahi a, apa Tura khomi, dalsekmi ahi. Amah dalsek lam himhim ah apil in atheisiam in akhutsiam petmah hi. Kumpipa Solomon kiang ah ahoh a, a-nna tengteng asepsak vek hi.
english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in bronze. He came to King Solomon and performed all his work.

paite: Dal khuam nih, tong sawm-le-giat a sang; akimvel a teh a tong sawm-le-nih a lian tuaktuak abawl hi.
heading: Dal Khuam Nihte / (2 Kro 3.15-17)
english: For he fashioned the two pillars of bronze, eighteen cubits high apiece; and a line of twelve cubits encircled either of them.

paite: Khuam lu a koih ding dal sunbawk nih abawl a; bawk khat sanlam tong nga ahi a, bawk khat pen sanlam tong nga mah ahi.
english: He made two capitals of molten bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

paite: Khuampite dawn ah lubawkte gial im-iam leh kihek nginngian a-om a; hiai lubawk kisuangsawn bel khainiang kiphan sagih, bawk khat pen a ding in leng sagih mah a kituam ahi.
english: There were nets of checker work and wreaths of chain work for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars: seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

paite: Huchi in khuamte abawl a; khuam lu a bawkte tuamna ding in gial im-iam khat tung ah akimvel vual nih a-om a; huchi mah bang in khat tung ah leng a-om lai hi.
english: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows of pomegranates around the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and he did so for the other capital.

paite: Inn lim a khuam dawn a bawk ah lili lim atuang a, huai tong li ahi.
english: The capitals that were on the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily work, four cubits.

paite: Khuam nih dawn a bawkte gei ah gial im-iam kiang ah theibuhfaite a-om a; theibuhfaite bel huai bawkte ah zanih tuaktuak a volh in a-om uhi.
english: There were capitals above also on the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network. There were two hundred pomegranates in rows around the other capital.

paite: Tempul inlim ah khuamte adingsak a; taklam khuam adingsak a, amin Jakin asa a; veilam khuam leng adingsak a; amin Boaz asa hi,
english: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

paite: Khuamte dawn ah lili lim atuang a; huchi in khuam lam nasep teng zohsiang ahita.
english: On the tops of the pillars was lily work. So the work of the pillars was finished.

paite: Dal tuibem lianpi, tong sawm, asanlam tong nga asung a; agei tong sawmthum kimvel ahi.
heading: Dal Tuibem / (2 Kro 4.2-5)
english: He made the molten sea ten cubits from brim to brim, round in shape. Its height was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits encircled it.

paite: Agei nuai ah pakmum lim in akimvel vek a, tong sawm ahi a, tuibem kimvel in a-om hi. Huai pakmumte vual nih in a-om ua, sunkhawm pah ahi.
english: Under its brim around there were buds which encircled it for ten cubits, encircling the sea. The buds were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

paite: Huai bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uhi. Atung uah tuibem akitung a, ameilam un asunglam adoh hi.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

paite: Khutpek chia a sah ahi a; agei lili pak bang, nou gei bang a bawl ahi. Bath sangnih takna ahi.
english: It was a hand width thick. Its brim was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.

paite: Dal in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; tunsawnna khat sau lam tong li ahi a, availam tong li mah ahi a, asanlam tong thum ahi.
heading: Dal Tunsawnnate
english: He made the ten bases of bronze. The length of one base was four cubits, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.

paite: Tunsawnna bawldan hichibang ahi. Huai in kuak anei a, huai kuakte ageite kikal ah a-om hi.
english: The work of the bases was like this: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

paite: Ageite kikal a kuakte ah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte leh cherubte atuang ua; agei tungte ah tunsawnna a-om hi. Humpinelkaite leh bawngtalte nuailam ah kilawmsaknate a-om dindian hi.
english: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

paite: Tunsawnnate ah dal kangtalai li leh dal tung chih a-om chiat a; aning lite ah kingakna a-om chiat hi. Kisilna nuailam ah akingakna sun a-om a, asik chiat ah kilawmsakna a-om chiat hi.
english: Every base had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze; and its four feet had supports. The supports were cast beneath the basin, with wreaths at the side of each.

paite: Valh gong sung tong khat ahi; akam kimvel valh bang a bem ahi a, tong khat-le-akim ahi. Akam gei kimvel gial kilawm ahi a, akuakte ning li ahi a, abem kei uh.
english: Its opening within the capital and above was a cubit. Its opening was round like the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also on its opening were engravings, and their panels were square, not round.

paite: Akuak nuailam ah kangtalai lite a-om ua; kangtalai tungchihte tunsawnna ah a-om uhi. Kangtalai sandan tong khat-le-akim ahi,
english: The four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axles of the wheels were in the base. The height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

paite: Huai kangtalaite bawldan sakol kangtalai khe bawldan bang ahi a; atungchihte, avalhte, asutkalhnate leh laibawkte avek a sun ahi.
english: The work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast metal.

paite: Tunsawnna ning li chiat ah kingakna li a-om a; huai kingaknate tunsawnna toh pum khat vek ahi uh.
english: There were four supports at the four corners of each base. Its supports were of the base itself.

paite: Tunsawnna tung ah valh, tong kimkhat a sang a-om a; tunsawnna tung a atunna khete leh akuakte pum khat vek ahi.
english: In the top of the base there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the base its supports and its panels were the same.

paite: Atunna khepekte leh akuakte ah azat bangbang in cherubte, humpinelkaite leh tum singte atuangsak a, akimvel in kilawmsakna a-om dindian hi.
english: On the plates of its supports and on its panels, he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, each in its space, with wreaths all around.

paite: Huchibang vek in tunsawnna sawm abawl a; avek in pum khat a sun ahi chiat ua, kikim chiat, bawldan kibang geih ahi chiat uh.
english: He made the ten bases in this way: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

paite: Kisilna bel sawm dal in abawl a; kisilna bel khat in bath sawmli adong a; kisilna bel tong li chiat ahi uh. Tunsawnna sawm tung ah kisilna bel khat akitung chiat hi.
english: He made ten basins of bronze. One basin contained forty baths. Every basin measured four cubits. One basin was on every one of the ten bases.

paite: Tunsawnnate inn taklam pang ah nga atung a, inn veilam pang ah nga mah. Tuibem pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simlam nga in atung hi.
english: He set the bases, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house. He set the sea on the right side of the house eastward and toward the south.

paite: Hiram in kisilna belte, vutluahte, maiphiat kuangte abawl a, huchi in TOUPA inn a dia Solomon abawlsak teng azousiangta hi.
heading: Tempul Vante Genna Tomkim / (2 Kro 4.11—5.1)
english: Hiram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished doing all the work that he worked for King Solomon in Yahweh’s house:

paite: Khuam nihte, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nihte, khuam dawn a bel ban a bawk nih tuamna gial im-iam nihte,
english: the two pillars; the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

paite: tuamna gial im-iam nih a dia theibuhfai zalite, khuam dawn a bel bang a bawk nih tuamna ding gial im-iam tuaktuak a dia theibuhfai vual nihte;
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;

paite: tunsawnna sawm leh tunsawnna tung a kisilna bel sawmte;
english: the ten bases; the ten basins on the bases;

paite: tuibem khat leh tuibem nuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte,
english: the one sea; the twelve oxen under the sea;

paite: belte, vutluahte leh maiphiat kuangte toh. Tui-um belsuan tengteng TOUPA' inn a dia Hiram in kumpipa Solomon abawlsak dal nawttet a bawl vek ahi.
english: the pots; the shovels; and the basins. All of these vessels, which Hiram made for King Solomon for Yahweh’s house, were of burnished bronze.

paite: Jordan Phaizang ah Sukkoth leh Zarethan kikal a bellei omna ah hiai teng kumpipa'n asung hi.
english: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

paite: Huai tui-um belsuan tengteng atam mahmah ziak in Solomon in buk khe lou in akoih a; dal bukzah pen theihkhiak ahi kei hi.
english: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA' inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a; dangka-eng maitam leh tanghou koihna dohkan dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: Solomon made all the vessels that were in Yahweh’s house: the golden altar and the table that the show bread was on, of gold;

paite: Mun siangthoupen ma a khawnvak koihnate, taklam a nga leh veilam a ngate dangka-eng siang in; pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: and the lamp stands, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary, of pure gold; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

paite: Noute, khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute leh mei laknate dangka-eng siang in; insung gilzaw, Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh inn, tempul, kongkhak bulhnate dangka-eng in aluan hi.
english: the cups, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and the fire pans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, of the temple, of gold.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl tengteng azouvekta hi. Huchi in Solomon in apa David in ana latkhitsa dangka chite, dangka-eng leh tui-um belsuante alalut a, TOUPA' inn a goute lak ah akoihta hi.
english: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh’s house.
